incident_spec.summary: Excessive creation of temporary tables on disk in MySQL due to query patterns and configuration limits.
symptoms: High percentage of temporary tables created on disk
incident_spec.mechanism: MySQL creates temporary tables on disk when memory-based limits (`tmp_table_size` and `max_heap_table_size`) are exceeded or when certain data types (e.g., TEXT/BLOB) are used.

facts.evidence: Post mentions 30% of temporary tables created on disk.
Answer explains TEXT/BLOB fields lead to disk-based temporary tables.

assumptions: Queries involve GROUP BY or ORDER BY operations with large result sets.
TEXT/BLOB fields are present in the schema.
unknowns: Query patterns causing temporary table creation
